questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF, now a national reference in unionism, is invited to an international congress. What message should he carry?
options: The union is a model of professional solidarity
The union is reserved for specialists
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union is a model of professional solidarity.' MIKOU: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must create a foundation to promote dental unionism. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Promoting solidarity and rights defense is essential for the future of the profession.' YOUSSEF: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must write a reference book on dental unionism. What is the central message?
options: Unionism is an art that combines engagement and solidarity
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Unionism is an art that combines engagement and solidarity.' MIKOU: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should he leave?
options: Unionism is evolving, full of opportunities
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Unionism is evolving, and opportunities are numerous.' YOUSSEF: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must create a union mentoring program. What is the main objective?
options: Transmit fundamental skills in union engagement
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental skills in union engagement.' MIKOU: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must manage the succession of his union engagement. What is the best strategy?
options: Gradually prepare the transmission of skills
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Gradual preparation for the transmission of skills is the key to a successful succession.' YOUSSEF: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must create a union charter for dental practices. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Solidarity and collective defense are the pillars of any union charter.' MIKOU: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must train future union mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of accompaniment and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of accompaniment and transmission.' YOUSSEF: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must prepare a testimony on his union career. What is the most striking element?
options: The satisfaction of having defended the profession
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The satisfaction of having defended the profession is the most striking element.' MIKOU: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must create an association of former unionists. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the bond and foster mutual help
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Mutual help and bonding are the driving forces of an alumni association.' YOUSSEF: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must write an article on the future of unionism. What trend should be emphasized?
options: Digital innovation in the service of mobilization
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Digital innovation must serve mobilization.' MIKOU: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must create a union quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Union engagement and solidarity are the fundamental criteria.' YOUSSEF: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should he leave?
options: The profession needs enthusiasts of unionism
The profession is of no interest
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The profession needs enthusiasts of unionism.' MIKOU: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must create an award for young unionized dentists. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Excellence in union engagement is the driving force of the evolution of the profession.' YOUSSEF: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must write his memoirs. What common thread should be highlighted?
options: The passion for unionism and service to the profession
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The passion for unionism is the common thread of a professional life.' MIKOU: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must create a union training center. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Training must train professionals in union engagement.' YOUSSEF: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Union skills and a role model to follow
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Union skills and a role model are the most beautiful legacy.' MIKOU: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must write a letter to future dentists about unionism. What message should it convey?
options: Unionism is a fascinating and promising discipline
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Unionism is a fascinating and promising discipline.' YOUSSEF: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must create a scholarship for students in unionism. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Supporting deserving students is an investment for the future of unionism.' MIKOU: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must give a closing speech. What note should he leave?
options: Unionism continues to evolve with those who carry it
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Unionism continues to evolve thanks to those who carry it.' YOUSSEF: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must pass on his union knowledge. What is the priority?
options: Sell his knowledge at the highest price
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Transmitting skills in continuity is the most beautiful achievement.' MIKOU: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must create a peer network for young unionized dentists. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual help and sharing of experiences
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Mutual help and sharing are essential for young unionized dentists.' YOUSSEF: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF must write a conclusion to his book. What is the final sentence?
options: Unionism is a magnificent human adventure
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Unionism is a magnificent human adventure.' MIKOU: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU must leave a message for future generations. What is the message?
options: Unionism is a discipline worth living
questions.explanation: MIKOU explains: 'Unionism is a discipline worth living.' YOUSSEF: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF, after a life dedicated to unionism, receives a national tribute. Dr. MIKOU is by his side. What is YOUSSEF's message to young dentists?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF concludes: 'Unionism needs passion and dedication to continue to evolve.' MIKOU: 'I am proud of you.'
